verdict.rationale: User-configurable background automations are a fair question for a cap-table SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no way for users to create or schedule autonomous automations. The only automatic behavior shown is a built-in vesting-event email alert, which is a fixed notification rather than a user-defined automation, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
